title: Yuan Shih Kai

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

November 11th.    1915

Sir,

The movement against the establishment of a Monarchy
in China is being very much underestimated by the Chinese
Authorities if they have in any way accurately gauged its
strength.

There is great jubilation in certain quarters over the
removal of Admiral Tseng and the opinion is being freely
expressed that the props on which Yuan Shih Kai is leaning
are being one by one removed.

There is also a tendency to glorify the two assassins
who are at present confined in Hongkew Station which will
grow much more if the detention is prolonged than it would
if they were swiftly dealt with and transferred from
the Settlement to the Arsenal.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：R. a. King
465
Date 2/7/16）
page_data.zh:
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

致上海工部局。

1915年11月11日

先生：

如果中国当局以任何方式准确评估了反对在中国建立君主制的运动之力量，那么他们便大大低估了该运动。

随着曾海军上将的免职，某些方面欢欣鼓舞，人们 freely 表达这样一种观点：袁世凯所依赖的支柱正被逐一移除。

此外，还有一种美化目前拘押在虹口捕房的两名刺客的倾向；如果拘留时间延长，这种倾向将比迅速处置并将他们从租界移交至兵工厂时增长得更为剧烈。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

（批注：R. a. King
465
日期 1916年7月2日）
